services.name: AI & ML Solutions
services.short: AI agents, document AI, RAG assistants and predictive analytics that work inside the software you already run.

hero.title: AI that works inside your business
hero.promise: We turn the data you already have — enquiries, invoices, purchase orders, test reports, customer history — into faster decisions and less manual work. One business problem, one fixed-scope pilot, measured against a real KPI.

problems: Your team answers the same customer, parent or supplier questions all day
Invoices, POs and application forms are still typed in by hand
Leads, dues and churn are spotted too late to act on
Reports exist, but nobody can ask them a simple question

deliverables.title: AI agents & assistants
deliverables.body: Assistants on WhatsApp, web and internal tools that answer queries and hand over to a person when needed.

deliverables.title: Generative AI & LLM integration
deliverables.body: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and Llama integrated into your existing software, with guardrails and cost tracking.

deliverables.title: Document intelligence
deliverables.body: Extract and validate data from invoices, forms, POs and applications; flag mismatches before money moves.

deliverables.title: Knowledge assistants (RAG)
deliverables.body: Ask questions of your own documents, policies and manuals, with answers that cite their source.

deliverables.title: Predictive analytics
deliverables.body: Lead scoring, demand forecasting, churn and dues prediction built on your own history.

deliverables.title: Natural-language dashboards
deliverables.body: Smart dashboards your managers can question in plain English.

faqs.q: How do we start with AI without a big budget?
faqs.a: With an AI Opportunity Audit: one or two sessions and a written report naming your top three use cases, expected impact, cost and the data each one needs. If one is worth doing, we run a fixed-scope 4–6 week pilot measured against a business KPI.

Your data stays yours. We use test or consented data for demos, keep a human in the loop for anything customer-facing or money-related, and log AI outputs for audit. For student and personal data we design to India's DPDP Act.
Any AI can. That is why money, admissions and customer-facing replies go through human review, and why every pilot is measured before it is scaled.

services.name: Custom Software & MVP
services.short: Web, mobile and SaaS products built from scratch — from first MVP to a platform that scales.

hero.title: From idea to launch-ready product
hero.promise: For founders and growing businesses that need software built properly the first time. A senior team designs, builds and ships your MVP, then scales it as your users grow — with AI built in where it pays off.

problems: You have an idea and a deadline, but no engineering team yet
Off-the-shelf tools don't fit how your business actually works
A previous vendor delivered something that can't scale
You need AI features in your product, not a slide about them

deliverables.title: MVP in weeks
deliverables.body: Scoped to the smallest product that proves your idea, built to production standards so you don't rebuild later.

deliverables.title: Web & mobile apps
deliverables.body: React and Next.js web apps, React Native mobile apps, one codebase where it makes sense.

deliverables.title: SaaS platforms
deliverables.body: Multi-tenant architecture, billing, roles and admin consoles for subscription products.

deliverables.title: Custom ERP & CRM
deliverables.body: Operations software shaped around your workflow — the same engineering behind our own ERP and CRM products.

deliverables.title: AI-ready from day one
deliverables.body: LLM features, search and analytics designed into the data model, not bolted on.

deliverables.title: Product team on demand
deliverables.body: Designers, full-stack and AI engineers who stay with your product after launch.

faqs.q: How long does an MVP take?
faqs.a: Most MVPs we scope land between 6 and 12 weeks. We agree the scope in writing before we start, so the timeline is a commitment, not a guess.
You do. Source code, infrastructure accounts and documentation are handed over to you.

faqs.q: Can you keep working with us after launch?
faqs.a: Yes. Most clients move to a dedicated team or a support retainer once the product is live.

services.name: Modernisation & Support
services.short: Take over, upgrade and run existing systems: legacy migration, cloud, AMC and dedicated engineering teams.

hero.title: Modernise what already works
hero.promise: For established businesses whose software runs the company but is getting old, slow or expensive. We take over safely, migrate to the cloud, keep it running and add new capability — including AI — without stopping operations.

problems: Critical software that only one person understands
Legacy systems that are slow, insecure or expensive to host
A vendor who no longer responds
No in-house team to maintain and improve what you have

deliverables.title: Code & architecture takeover
deliverables.body: Audit, documentation and a stabilisation plan before we change anything.

deliverables.title: Legacy modernisation
deliverables.body: Incremental migration to modern stacks, with both systems running in parallel until the cut-over is proven.

deliverables.title: Cloud migration
deliverables.body: Move to AWS or Azure with Docker, Terraform and CI/CD — and a hosting bill you can predict.

deliverables.title: AMC & ongoing support
deliverables.body: Annual maintenance contracts with response times, patches, backups and monitoring.

deliverables.title: Dedicated teams & staffing
deliverables.body: Vetted AI, full-stack and cloud engineers who join your team for months, not days.

deliverables.title: Product implementation
deliverables.body: Implementation, data migration, training and support for customers of our own products.

faqs.q: Can you take over software another vendor built?
faqs.a: Yes. We start with a paid audit of the code, hosting and data, then propose a stabilisation plan. Nothing is rewritten until we understand it.

faqs.q: Will our operations stop during migration?
faqs.a: No. We migrate incrementally and run old and new systems in parallel until the new one is proven.

faqs.q: Do you provide engineers on contract?
faqs.a: Yes — AI, full-stack and cloud engineers, individually or as a managed team.

services.name: Technology Consulting
services.short: CTO-as-a-service, architecture reviews, AI readiness and digital transformation roadmaps.

hero.title: Senior technology judgement, when you need it
hero.promise: Leadership with 20+ years of enterprise delivery, available without hiring a full-time CTO. We help you decide what to build, buy, fix or automate — and in what order.

problems: Big technology decisions with nobody senior to check them
AI is on the board's agenda, but no one knows where to start
Vendors are quoting very different prices for the same thing
Your platform needs to scale, but you're not sure what will break first

deliverables.title: AI Opportunity Audit
deliverables.body: One or two sessions and a written report: your top three AI use cases, expected impact, cost and the data each needs.

deliverables.title: CTO-as-a-service
deliverables.body: A part-time technology leader for roadmap, hiring, vendor management and architecture decisions.

deliverables.title: Architecture & code review
deliverables.body: An independent review of security, scalability and cost, with a prioritised fix list.

deliverables.title: Digital transformation roadmap
deliverables.body: Which processes to digitise, automate or retire — sequenced by business value.

deliverables.title: Cloud & AI consulting
deliverables.body: AWS and Azure architecture, LLM model choice and cost-per-transaction planning.

deliverables.title: Vendor & RFP support
deliverables.body: Requirement writing and independent evaluation of vendor proposals.

faqs.q: What does the AI Opportunity Audit cost?
faqs.a: Contact us for current pricing. The output is a written report you keep, whether or not you work with us afterwards.

faqs.q: Do you only recommend your own products?
faqs.a: No. Where an off-the-shelf tool fits better, we say so.
